import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    w = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])

    digits = []
    while m != 0:
        digits.append(m % w)
        m //= w

    ok = True
    i = 0
    while i < len(digits):
        digit = digits[i]
        if digit == 0 or digit == 1:
            i += 1
            continue
        if digit == w - 1:
            # carry to higher digits
            j = i + 1
            while j < len(digits):
                if digits[j] == w - 1:
                    digits[j] = 0
                    j += 1
                else:
                    digits[j] += 1
                    break
            i += 1
            continue
        ok = False
        break

    print("YES" if ok else "NO")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
